what: Other answerers' answers on every DCLab test, each kept whole in lake/bronze/answers/<answerer>/<source>/ (not committed; kept permanently by make archive): the text and schema asked, the raw output, the value, the confidence, the model's revision, the time; the true answers stay in the tests (lake/gold, lake/bronze/decisions).
rule: Agreement is computed on dev only and says how the answerer reads these tests, not that it is ready to serve; the sealed split is answered but never scored here.
